title: Aspect and reframe payload
summary: JSON Schema for the aspect/reframe detector payload - frame and content aspect names and ratios, content rectangle, reframing method, fill evidence and upscale factor.
description: Emitted as the envelope payload by video_re_detect_aspect_reframe; the envelope itself follows the baltor.video-detection/v1 schema.

review.notes: Valid example validates and invalid example fails (Draft 2020-12); the detector's tests validate every emitted payload against this schema.
